title: LTX prompt manifest
description: episodes/<slug>/<EPID>/_context/ltx-prompt-manifest.json — written at 04f3 by tools/ltx_prompt_manifest.py, never by hand. Binds each final clip prompt to the exact still it was re-anchored against, by hash, so 04g can prove a package matches the prompts it was built from.

render.description: Copied from channel.json -> render at compile time, so a manifest records what it was authored against even if the profile later changes.

index.description: The integer used in the render package's @@ s{n} marker AND in the still's filename. app-vidgen-dist matches a still to its prompt by the scene number that PREFIXES the filename stem (SC07.png -> 7; a suffix like _v2 is ignored), so these must agree.

prompt_path.description: Always prompts/7-video-prompts.md — the single canonical clip-prompt file. There are no per-clip .txt files; the addressable unit is the `## SCnn` block.

prompt_sha256.description: SHA-256 of this clip's `## SCnn` block body (the prose the render receives, after the header and any `[[TAG]]` line are stripped).

still_generator.description: The image model that produced this still (e.g. muse-image-1.0, or muse-image-1.0 via local_skills/muse-image). Provenance only; written by tools/ltx_prompt_manifest.py from --still-generator or channel.json models.image.

declared_cuts.description: 0 for a single continuous take, which is the i2v default. A non-zero value means the prose names that many explicit cuts, each with a transition, a re-established shot, and stated audio continuity.

camera_movement.description: Taken from blocking.json's camera.movement — recorded here so 05a can check the render against the decision rather than against an impression.

frame0_requirements.description: The clip's block from frame0-requirements.json, embedded so this manifest is self-contained.

is_pilot.description: Marked at 04g; watched by a human at 04h before the full batch renders.
